ideas.idea_fa: Key cutting workshop and key duplicating machine

prompts.note: Check that the key teeth are not irregular or melted.
prompts.prompt: Brass and nickel key blanks fanned out beside a single freshly cut key on a pale grey concrete slab, soft overhead softbox light, 100mm macro lens, crisp brushed metal texture with fine filing marks, calm minimal mood, wide empty space on the right

prompts.note: Check the machine parts and clamps for illogical shapes.
prompts.prompt: Compact key duplicating machine on a worn wooden workbench in a small locksmith workshop, fine metal shavings around the clamp, warm tungsten desk lamp, 35mm lens at a low three-quarter angle, rows of blank hooks on a pegboard behind, cozy craftsman mood, empty wall space at top

prompts.note: The background person’s face must stay blurred; check the hands.

ideas.why_fa: Small businesses and local service trades are under-supplied B2B topics, and early in the year, as offices and tenants move, demand for keys and lock changes rises; this niche is different from last month’s ideas (shops and installation).

reports.summary_fa: Adobe recommends uploading seasonal content about 3 months early, so this month targets February 2027: Lunar New Year (about 6 February), the start of Ramadan (about 8 February), Valentine’s Day and the peak of heating and frost season. 2026 trends that are still under-supplied: sustainable technology (energy, biodegradable packaging, urban farming), the silver economy, and Adobe’s “All the feels” (texture and sensory detail) and “Local flavours” (local makers). Buyers prefer a real, slightly imperfect look to glossy artificial AI. Avoid saturated topics: generic office meetings, neon tech, abstract charts and data, spring blossom and the default AI face; send at most 3 different versions of each idea in one batch.

reports.summary_fa: This month work for February and early March 2027: Lunar New Year (6 February), the start of Ramadan and iftar (8 February), Valentine’s dinner, Eid al-Fitr (about 9 March) and Nowruz. In October 2026 Whole Foods announced eight 2027 food trends: Bean Boom, Yōshoku (Western food Japanese-style), Bitter Done Better, Dish Reinvention, Terroir, Beautrition, Ingredient Minimalism and Zero Waste 2.0; these are still under-supplied on stock sites. Natural light, real food texture and handmade dishes fit Adobe’s All the Feels trend. Avoid hands in close-ups and readable labels, and check the number of spoons, glasses and chopsticks at 100% zoom.
